name: Allora
kurzbeschreibung: Discover Innsbruck – The Heart of the Alps Welcome to Tirol’s glittering gem!
beschreibung: The **Allora** in **Innsbruck** is the perfect spot for a quick yet delicious pick-me-up. With a varied selection of hot and cold snacks, savory bites, and sweet treats, there’s something for everyone. Every dish is prepared with care and fresh ingredients—whether it’s hearty sausage specialties, crispy schnitzel in a roll, or vegetarian options. The friendly staff ensures fast service and a smile on every guest’s face. Perfect for a break while exploring the region, a quick lunch, or a snack on the go—**Allora** delivers solid quality at fair prices in **Innsbruck**.
